newsitem.title: USA: Mission West sets special cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mission West sets special cash dividend.

text.p: Mission West Properties on Wednesday declared a special cash dividend of $9.00 per share on its common stock, payable February 27 to shareholders of record on February 19.
The company completed the sale of most of its real estate assets in January, and the dividend represents the currently available portion of the net proceeds from those sales.

Completing the sale of its leasehold properties at Palomar-McClellan Airport was deferred until a date not more than 120 days after January 22 . It is under contract for sale at $3 million, subject to payment of transaction costs.

In a statement, Mission West said its shares will trade ex-dividend on February 28. Shareholders are advised that if they sell their shares before that date, they will transfer the right to receive the dividend to the purchasers of the shares.
